title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入細線 RDL、過孔連通與跨材料可靠度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore fine rdl, via continuity and cross-material reliability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 介面與版圖
stages.description: 針對介面與版圖完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interfaces and layout, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 互連功能分層｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Interconnect function layers | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對互連功能分層，把「電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For interconnect function layers, turn "Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「互連功能分層」的模型：電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「標每層網路及回流面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for interconnect function layers: Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Mark networks and return planes per layer. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 標每層網路及回流面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark networks and return planes per layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：最小線寬可用於所有電源線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using minimum width for all power traces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付互連功能分層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for interconnect function layers, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 互連功能分層：機制
knowledge.text: 電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。
knowledge.textEn: Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 標每層網路及回流面。 必須排除的錯判：最小線寬可用於所有電源線。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Mark networks and return planes per layer. Misinterpretation to reject: Using minimum width for all power traces. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「互連功能分層」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For interconnect function layers — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。
最小線寬可用於所有電源線
中心偏差合格就必有足夠邊界
optionsEn: Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents.
Using minimum width for all power traces
Assuming acceptable center error guarantees edge margin
quiz.explanation: 電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。 標每層網路及回流面。 因此不能採用「最小線寬可用於所有電源線」。
quiz.explanationEn: Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents. Mark networks and return planes per layer. Therefore reject: Using minimum width for all power traces.

steps.title: 互連功能分層｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Interconnect function layers | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對互連功能分層，把「電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For interconnect function layers, turn "Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：標每層網路及回流面。 將「最小線寬可用於所有電源線」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Mark networks and return planes per layer. Challenge the hypothesis "Using minimum width for all power traces" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 標每層網路及回流面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark networks and return planes per layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：最小線寬可用於所有電源線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using minimum width for all power traces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付互連功能分層的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for interconnect function layers: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 介電層與固化｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Dielectric and cure | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對介電層與固化，把「介電層的厚度、吸濕和固化影響電容與附著。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For dielectric and cure, turn "Thickness, moisture and cure affect capacitance and adhesion." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「介電層與固化」的模型：介電層的厚度、吸濕和固化影響電容與附著。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「配對厚度、漏電及剝離見證。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for dielectric and cure: Thickness, moisture and cure affect capacitance and adhesion. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Pair thickness, leakage and adhesion witnesses. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 配對厚度、漏電及剝離見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Pair thickness, leakage and adhesion witnesses. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：介電層只需看擊穿電壓。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assessing dielectric only by breakdown voltage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付介電層與固化的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for dielectric and cure, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

所有銅沉積都可用塊材延展性
比較頂部尺寸與孔底截面。
optionsEn: Assuming a visible opening has a clean bottom
Using bulk ductility for every deposited Cu film
Compare top dimensions with bottom sections.
quiz.explanation: 底部殘留和側壁形狀決定金屬連通。 比較頂部尺寸與孔底截面。 因此不能採用「頂視過孔打開即底部必潔淨」。
quiz.explanationEn: Bottom residue and wall profile determine metal continuity. Compare top dimensions with bottom sections. Therefore reject: Assuming a visible opening has a clean bottom.
